planned_by: Owner request (2026-10-27): 'no ID/password — I am the only user'
goal:
OWNER DECISION: the web must not ask for an ID or password; the owner is the only user. Keep everything else private.
SPEC: (1) New server-only env EVO_WEB_AUTH with values 'session' (current behaviour, default) and 'none'. With 'none': apps/web/middleware.ts lets every page through; /login and /login/* redirect (307) to /; app/api/login/route.ts and app/api/logout/route.ts return 404; app/api/me/route.ts returns 200 {user: 'owner', auth: 'none'}; the proxy app/api/evoforge/[...path]/route.ts no longer requires a session but keeps the path policy, the server-side metadata ID token to the private API and everything else. Read EVO_WEB_AUTH at runtime (not build time); any value other than 'none' means 'session'. (2) Guardrail because the web origin becomes the only gate: in 'none' mode the proxy rate-limits mutating requests (POST) per client IP (first x-forwarded-for entry) to EVO_WEB_POST_PER_MIN (default 20) per rolling minute -> 429 {error:'rate limited'} without contacting the API; GET is not limited. (3) Remove any login link/redirect from page code when auth is 'none' (pages must render without a session cookie). (4) Production service wording; no secrets in NEXT_PUBLIC_*. Keep 'session' mode fully working (it stays the default).
check: cd apps\web && node node_modules\typescript\bin\tsc --noEmit --incremental false -p . && node node_modules\next\dist\bin\next build
